name: Pupa
author: nathankramm
description: Pupa: Monarch Money on your Omarchy bar. A starting stage: fork it and grow it into your own.

barWidget.description: This month's spending pace against your usual month, as a butterfly. Hover for the card, click for Monarch. Read-only; unofficial.

schema.label: Engine command
schema.description: The command run on every tick. Its last stdout line is the whole display: the glyph, the face state and every string on the card.

schema.label: Tick (seconds)
schema.description: How often the engine is run. It reads its cache; it asks Monarch at most once an hour whatever this says.

schema.label: Hover
schema.description: What a hover over the butterfly shows: the card, or the same strings as a plain text tooltip.

schema.label: Tint the butterfly by pace
schema.description: Green at or under a usual month, amber ahead of it. Off paints it in the bar's own color; stale and broken look the same either way.
